analyst_view.overall: Bottom side Venezia (6 points from 12) host in-form Bologna (9th, unbeaten in five: four wins and a 1-1 with Udinese) at the Penzo on Friday. Davide Nicola's Venezia lost 4-0 at Juventus last weekend and have scored only 3 in six; right-sided defenders Mazzocchi and Correia have thigh strains and are doubtful, Basic is a fitness doubt, and Sverko and Franjic are out. Raffaele Palladino's Bologna are without Holm (long-term) and Happonen, Miranda and Enem are doubts, and Heggem was left out of the last squad for disciplinary reasons. The numbers carry no player list for this game, but the absences on both sides are mostly at the back and roughly cancel out, and the numbers already count Bologna's strong corner and shooting form and Venezia's few bookings. No referee is named yet; I stay with the numbers on every stat.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, 1.6 for Bologna. Venezia barely score (3 in six) and Bologna have 12 in six, which the numbers already count; Venezia's doubtful full-backs and Bologna's missing defenders pull in opposite directions, so I stay at about 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners, 4.8 for Bologna. Bologna's wide play has won 39 corners in six and Venezia have conceded 40, which the numbers already add; if Mazzocchi and Correia miss out Venezia lose some width on the right, but that is a doubt rather than confirmed, so I stay at about 8.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards. Venezia have been booked only 5 times in six games and the numbers already take about 8% off for it; a relegation-threatened home side could get edgier, but no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 3.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 25.2 shots, 14.2 for Bologna. Bologna's 91 shots in six are already counted, and Venezia under Nicola still get shots off (75 in six) even when losing. I stay at about 25.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, 4.8 for Bologna. Bologna's sharp finishing lately (33 on target in six) is already added and Venezia's low accuracy too; nothing in the team news changes the forwards on either side, so I stay at about 8.3.
